sides.source_endpoint_selection: Distal external iliac endpoint and proximal femoral endpoint selected by source part identity and superior/inferior course, not minimum pair distance.
sides.unresolved_reason: All mesh outline paths have near-zero projected area; no terminal opening ring supports these extraction endpoints. Endpoint chord spans adjacent source courses rather than a confirmed missing lumen segment. Requires source-coordinate/part overlap and anatomical transition review before a synthetic cut or bridge.
